page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number 109 at right; one column of text; a centred closing line "Amen."; a woodcut ornament below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: tamen repulsam passus dici poterit, vt qui nihil nisi addita conditione petierit, à quae-tiam postea totus pependit. Sed in eo fuit exauditus, quòd mortis depositò pauore, victor, hostem prior aggreditur, vt in sequentibus fauente Deo sumus exposituri. Faxit verò Deus Opt. Max. vt haec tam ardua, tam magna, tam eximia, tam denique necessaria mysteria probè cognita, diligenter meditemur, & quandiu vita fruimur in vsum suum ad Nominis ipsius gloriam, & nostram salutem reuocemus,

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. The "Amen." line is centred and is given as a paragraph, not a heading. Some words in the scan are faint or broken (for example "repulsam", "pependit"); they were read as printed.
